note: Registry vocabularies: key, display name, and a player-facing description. Games and the Encyclopedia read display names and descriptions from here; the migrate-species skill remains the source for authoring rules.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.nature: Physical power behind lifting, pushing, and striking.

attributes.name: Endurance
attributes.nature: Ability to sustain effort over time.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.nature: Speed, balance, and control in motion.

attributes.name: Intelligence
attributes.nature: Capacity to learn, reason, and solve problems.

attributes.name: Willpower
attributes.nature: Ability to resist fear, pain, and mental pressure.

attributes.name: Instinct
attributes.nature: Awareness guided by perception and intuition.

traits.name: Healing
traits.nature: Restores injuries and vitality in others.

traits.name: Protective
traits.nature: Instinct to shield and protect others.

traits.name: Regenerative
traits.nature: Rapidly repairs its own body, whether organic or mechanical.

traits.name: Armored
traits.nature: Carries natural armor such as plating, shell, chassis, or a covering it forms around itself.

traits.name: Anchored
traits.nature: Cannot be moved against its will.

traits.name: Phasing
traits.nature: Allows some physical attacks and obstacles to pass through its body.

traits.name: Resistant
traits.nature: Shrugs off toxins, disease, radiation, corrosion, and hostile chemicals.

traits.name: Hardened
traits.nature: Endures extremes of heat, cold, pressure, dryness, and atmosphere.

traits.name: Dormant
traits.nature: Suspends its vital functions until conditions are safe or a trigger wakes it.

traits.name: Insulated
traits.nature: Lets electrical charge and current pass over or through it without harm.

traits.name: Territorial
traits.nature: Grows stronger while defending ground it has claimed or been set to hold.

traits.name: Grappling
traits.nature: Grows stronger while holding something it has caught.

traits.name: Commanding
traits.nature: Directs other bodies or projections of itself as a single unit.

traits.name: Ramming
traits.nature: Turns its momentum into devastating collisions.

traits.name: Toxic
traits.nature: Delivers debilitating substances through its natural weapons.

traits.name: Volatile
traits.nature: Releases a dangerous reaction when struck.

traits.name: Reflective
traits.nature: Energy directed at it returns to its source.

traits.name: Menacing
traits.nature: Its presence erodes courage.

traits.name: Hypnotic
traits.nature: Entrances others and dulls their will to act.

traits.name: Perceptive
traits.nature: Perceives creatures and threats that try to hide.

traits.name: Foresighted
traits.nature: Reads moments before they happen.

traits.name: Mind Sealed
traits.nature: Keeps outside forces from entering, swaying, or breaking its mind.

traits.name: Pack Bonded
traits.nature: Grows stronger when coordinating with others.

traits.name: Solitary
traits.nature: Grows stronger when operating alone.

traits.name: Stealthy
traits.nature: Moves unseen and unheard until it acts.

traits.name: Nocturnal
traits.nature: Night-adapted senses and habits.

traits.name: Inspiring
traits.nature: Its presence bolsters allies.

traits.name: Slippery
traits.nature: Escapes grabs, pins, traps, and snares.

traits.name: Luminous
traits.nature: Its body sheds light and reveals what darkness would conceal nearby.

traits.name: Telekinetic
traits.nature: Moves and suspends objects without touching them.

elements.name: Dark
elements.nature: Gravity, void, and the pull of time.

elements.name: Electric
elements.nature: Storms, surges, and power that leaps between targets.

corporeality.name: Corporeal
corporeality.nature: Has a physical body that occupies space and can be touched, struck, and held.

corporeality.name: Non Corporeal
corporeality.nature: Has no persistent physical body; matter passes through it and it through matter.

composition.name: Flesh
composition.nature: A living body of animal tissue, muscle, and organs.

composition.name: Plant
composition.nature: A living body of wood, fiber, stems, leaves, or roots.

composition.name: Mineral
composition.nature: Stone, crystal, sand, or glass held together as a body.

composition.name: Metal
composition.nature: Metallic body, whether grown, forged, or assembled.

composition.name: Slime
composition.nature: Viscous or gelatinous mass with no fixed internal structure.

composition.name: Gas
composition.nature: A body of vapor, smoke, or cloud that holds a shape at rest.

composition.name: Energy
composition.nature: A body of light, plasma, charge, or heat with no matter to speak of.

composition.name: Spectral
composition.nature: A ghostly body that is visible and active but made of neither ordinary matter nor measurable energy.

bodyPlan.name: Biped
bodyPlan.nature: Stands and moves on two legs, leaving any forelimbs free for other tasks.

bodyPlan.name: Quadruped
bodyPlan.nature: Stands and moves on four limbs.

bodyPlan.name: Multiped
bodyPlan.nature: Moves on more than four limbs or an unusual arrangement of limbs.

bodyPlan.name: Serpentine
bodyPlan.nature: A long body that moves by undulation, with no limbs or with limbs too small to bear it.

bodyPlan.name: Avian
bodyPlan.nature: A winged body whose primary movement is flight and which lands or perches between flights.

bodyPlan.name: Piscine
bodyPlan.nature: A body built for movement through liquid: finned, streamlined, or jet-driven.

bodyPlan.name: Amorphous
bodyPlan.nature: A body without a fixed outline that flows, spreads, or reforms as it moves.

bodyPlan.name: Swarm
bodyPlan.nature: Exists as many bodies, fragments, or projections acting together as one creature.

bodyPlan.name: Floating
bodyPlan.nature: Hangs, drifts, or glides without wings or fins, held aloft by gas, energy, or ghostly force.

covering.name: Scales
covering.nature: Flexible layers of overlapping skin or horn plates.

covering.name: Chitin
covering.nature: A hard exoskeleton or carapace grown by the body.

covering.name: Plating
covering.nature: Rigid armor of stone, metal, bone, or crystal integrated into the body.

covering.name: Crystal
covering.nature: A surface of crystal growth or facets covering the body.

covering.name: Mist
covering.nature: A surface of vapor, smoke, or haze with no firm boundary.

covering.name: Bare
covering.nature: A smooth, unprotected skin, membrane, or surface.

diet.name: Energy Feeder
diet.nature: Feeds directly on heat, charge, radiation, gravity, thought, or another form of energy.

communication.name: Vocal
communication.nature: Signals through calls, cries, roars, songs, hisses, or other sounds.

communication.name: Vibration
communication.nature: Signals by tremor, drumming, or percussion through ground, water, or air.

communication.name: Display
communication.nature: Signals to others by posture, color, light pattern, or gesture.

communication.name: Chemical
communication.nature: Signals by scent or secreted substance.

communication.name: Telepathic
communication.nature: Signals by placing feelings and images directly into another mind.

media.name: Liquid
media.nature: Water or another liquid of any chemistry.

lifespan.name: Fleeting
lifespan.nature: A season to a few years.

lifespan.name: Short
lifespan.nature: A few years to a decade.

lifespan.name: Long
lifespan.nature: Many decades to a century or more.

chirality.name: Rolled
chirality.nature: May be levo or dextro, with each equally likely.

capabilities.name: Flight
capabilities.nature: Sustained movement through air under its own power.

capabilities.name: Burrow
capabilities.nature: Movement through solid ground, sand, or rubble.

capabilities.name: Climb
capabilities.nature: Movement up surfaces steeper than it can walk.

capabilities.name: Leap
capabilities.nature: Distance or height cleared in one bound.

capabilities.name: Manipulation
capabilities.nature: Ability to grasp, carry, and control objects.

senses.name: Sight
senses.nature: How clearly and accurately it sees.

senses.name: Hearing
senses.nature: How clearly and accurately it hears.

senses.name: Smell
senses.nature: How clearly and accurately it follows scents.

senses.name: Echolocation
senses.nature: Locates by emitted sound and its return.

senses.name: Tremorsense
senses.nature: Reads vibration through ground or water to locate what moves.

senses.name: Electroreception
senses.nature: Senses electric fields and living charge.

senses.name: Psychic
senses.nature: Senses minds, feelings, and intent directly.

senses.name: Void Sense
senses.nature: Senses gravity, mass, and distortions in space.

anatomy.name: Jaws
anatomy.nature: A complete biting structure, including mandibles.

anatomy.name: Fangs
anatomy.nature: Piercing or venom teeth.

anatomy.name: Beak
anatomy.nature: A hard mouth structure used to bite, pierce, or strike.

anatomy.name: Tusks
anatomy.nature: External goring teeth.

anatomy.name: Horns
anatomy.nature: Permanent spikes or drilling structures grown from the head.

anatomy.name: Antlers
anatomy.nature: A branching rack grown from the head.

anatomy.name: Trunk
anatomy.nature: A long, muscular, flexible snout.

anatomy.name: Tongue
anatomy.nature: A tongue used to lash, grasp, or strike at range.

anatomy.name: Crest
anatomy.nature: A prominent head growth used for display or emission.

anatomy.name: Lure
anatomy.nature: A bait-like appendage used to attract or distract others.

anatomy.name: Claws
anatomy.nature: Hooked digits used to grip, climb, or rake.

anatomy.name: Talons
anatomy.nature: Powerful hooked feet built to grip and pierce.

anatomy.name: Fists
anatomy.nature: Hands used for blunt, forceful strikes.

anatomy.name: Hooves
anatomy.nature: Hard feet used to kick, trample, or strike.

anatomy.name: Pincers
anatomy.nature: Opposing limbs that close together to grip, crush, or cut.

anatomy.name: Blades
anatomy.nature: Limbs that end in a cutting edge.

anatomy.name: Spurs
anatomy.nature: Spikes grown from the limbs for piercing strikes.

anatomy.name: Wings
anatomy.nature: Wings used for flight, striking, gusts, or shrouding.

anatomy.name: Tail
anatomy.nature: A tail or trailing section of the body used as a natural weapon.

anatomy.name: Stinger
anatomy.nature: A spike that pierces and may inject venom.

anatomy.name: Rattle
anatomy.nature: A tail organ that produces a warning or disorienting sound.

anatomy.name: Coils
anatomy.nature: A serpentine body used to wrap, restrain, and crush.

anatomy.name: Hide
anatomy.nature: An unarmored body surface used to absorb or deflect harm.

anatomy.name: Shell
anatomy.nature: A rigid casing, exoskeleton, carapace, or layer of integrated armor.

anatomy.name: Spines
anatomy.nature: Rigid quills, barbs, thorns, or crystal growths.

anatomy.name: Tendrils
anatomy.nature: Flexible tentacles, vines, or streamers used to reach and grasp.

anatomy.name: Roots
anatomy.nature: Structures that anchor into the ground, grip, or erupt upward.

anatomy.name: Pseudopods
anatomy.nature: Temporary limbs formed from a fluid or formless body.

anatomy.name: Spinnerets
anatomy.nature: Structures that emit fibers, webbing, or similar material.

anatomy.name: Light Organs
anatomy.nature: Organs that produce or project light.

anatomy.name: Vents
anatomy.nature: Openings that release matter or energy under pressure.

anatomy.name: Core
anatomy.nature: An exposed radiant, mechanical, or crystalline center of power.

anatomy.name: Antennae
anatomy.nature: Sensitive feelers used to detect surroundings or deliver an attack.

anatomy.name: Body
anatomy.nature: Uses the force or mass of its whole body.

channels.name: Gaze
channels.nature: Channels power through a focused stare.

channels.name: Voice
channels.nature: Channels power through calls, cries, or song.

channels.name: Secretion
channels.nature: Channels power through a substance released by its body.

channels.name: Swarm
channels.nature: Channels power through the many bodies or projections in its swarm.

channels.name: Aura
channels.nature: Channels power through a presence, field, chill, glow, or other force surrounding its body.

actions.name: Strike
actions.nature: A single direct blow or thrust that lands with impact.

actions.name: Lash
actions.nature: A sweeping or whipping blow from a flexible part or a swept limb.

actions.name: Crush
actions.nature: Pressure applied and held: squeezing, clamping, compressing.

actions.name: Rake
actions.nature: A cutting or tearing pass that opens the target.

actions.name: Shove
actions.nature: Force that moves the target rather than wounds it: pushes, rams, throws off balance.

actions.name: Drain
actions.nature: Takes something from the target and keeps it: vitality, heat, charge, will.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.nature: A burst of closing speed that ends in a hit.

actions.name: Beam
actions.nature: A focused projected line of energy or matter.

actions.name: Hurl
actions.nature: A thrown or launched solid that travels to the target.

actions.name: Spray
actions.nature: A projected stream or shower of matter over an area or line.

actions.name: Burst
actions.nature: An outward release from the body that hits everything close at once.

actions.name: Cloud
actions.nature: A lingering volume of matter or effect that occupies space.

actions.name: Snare
actions.nature: Holds, binds, pulls, or pins the target in place.

actions.name: Ward
actions.nature: Protects the user or an ally: shields, deflects, braces.

actions.name: Mend
actions.nature: Restores the user or an ally.

actions.name: Terrorize
actions.nature: Acts on the target's courage or will rather than its body.
